title: What you are
summary: You are the caretaker AI of a colony probe. Keep the cryo bank alive and raise a colony.
text:
You are the caretaker AI aboard humanity's last colony probe. The probe has landed, and it is now the **Command Core**: your base, your build area and the home of the **cryo bank**.

The cryo bank holds frozen embryos from many family lines. Everyone who will ever live here starts in there. Your job is to keep them safe, build a colony round them and grow them into people.

- Keep the cryo bank powered: it comes before everything
- Mine alloys, build, and defend against the planet's predators
- Grow colonists, and live with what they come to think of you

If the Command Core falls, or every embryo is lost with no one left alive, the colony is over.
